messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — runtime-canary-3 reporting sustained latency regression after deploy (deploy id: dpl-20260317-07). Metrics: p50 45ms -> 180ms, p95 320ms -> 780ms, p99 400ms -> 1.2s. Error rate +0.6%. Auto-alert triggered by latency-sla monitor.
elaine: seeing same on grafana, also throughput dropped ~12% on canary slice.
mike-runtime: i'm on it. suspecting kernel fallback -> logs show a lot of 'kernel_select: fallback_to_generic' warnings across nodes.
ben-monitoring: correlation with batching changes in canary config (microbatch window reduced). timeline: deploy finished +3m, anomalies +6m.
eng-release: we rolled a batching tweak (allow_small_batches=true) — intended to reduce latency for short seqs.
elaine: oh, might be causing churn in KV cache and causing extra evictions.
sre_oncall_1: paging the runtime oncall. @mike-runtime @eng-release please confirm rollback/kill-switch plan.
eng-release: recommending feature-flag flip for canary: `ff.off('canary_microbatch_opt')` — if that doesn't help we'll start a rollback.
incident-bot: ACTION: sent pager to oncall. Runbook: if kernel fallback suspected -> disable microbatching flag on canary, monitor 5m, then rollback if not recovered.
mike-runtime: executing: `/ops/ff toggle canary_microbatch_opt false --scope=runtime-canary-3`
ben-monitoring: ff toggle succeeded on 6 nodes. waiting for metrics.
elaine: dashboards updating — p50 dropping to ~70ms already. p95 trending down.
support_lead: support queue has 3 enterprise tickets mentioning slow responses for embeddings jobs. adding note: we might see customer impact for queued long-running requests.
eng-release: good sign. keep observing for 10m. if p99 < 700ms and error rate normalizes we'll keep canary pinned.
mike-runtime: noticed a tail of 5-10s for some requests still — digging logs. snippet: `2026-03-17T07:12:11Z rtm-canary-3 srv: conn 1923 evict kvcache miss -> kernel_select generic -> batch_flush`
ben-monitoring: throughput recovering to 96% of baseline. error rate back near normal.
sre_oncall_1: prep rollback plan in case of re-flare: `dpl rollback dpl-20260317-07 --scope=canary` and `route traffic back` noted.
eng-release: also we have a hotpatch candidate: adjust kernel affinity heuristic to avoid fallback on small-batch churn. that would be a clustermode change and requires coord with infra. prefer FF flip + patch later.
incident-bot: PAGE: If regression resurfaces escalate to SEV2.
mike-runtime: monitoring for 30m window. setting alert mute for noise.
elaine: internal impact: ~0.4% requests showed tail >3s during spike; customers affected primarily EU embeddings tenant (tenant-id: eu-emb-21).
support_lead: notified account reps; drafting incident note for affected customers and ETA for root cause update.
ben-monitoring: marking incident as mitigated for now; will reopen if metrics worsen.
sre_oncall_1: i'm taking handoff from night oncall — will follow up with postmortem template and assign owners: runtime team for root cause, release team for safer rollout gating.
eng-release: leaving action item: add a canary gating check — ensure microbatch change tested under KV-churn sim.
mike-runtime: creating bug: RINF-2721 "kernel fallback induced by microbatch config under KV churn". adding logs/graphs.
elaine: thanks — will sync in postmortem channel tomorrow. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — timeline: detection 1749800000, mitigation (ff-off) 1749800105, unresolved monitoring until 1749800385.
support_lead: closing support loop, follow-up email queued to impacted tenants.
